basic_info.description: Perfectly situated where vibrant NOPA meets iconic Alamo Square, 1524 McAllister is a grand, full-floor Victorian condominium that blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication. Soaring ceilings, exquisite period details, and expansive scale pair beautifully with curated contemporary updates. The bright living room features dramatic curved bow windows, while the newly renovated chef's kitchen includes designer finishes, top-tier appliances (including a Bosch range), and a large walk-in pantry. Entertain in style in the formal dining room with original built-ins. The home offers 3 spacious bedrooms and a home office, ideal for today's lifestyle. A laundry room, deeded independent parking and storage, and access to a shared landscaped garden offer comfort and convenience. Just one block from the vibrant Divisadero corridor and the heart of NOPA, this location offers immediate access to top-rated restaurants, cozy cafes, boutique shops, local markets and the weekly Divisadero Farmers' Market. Enjoy nearby Alamo Square, the Panhandle's scenic walking and biking trails, and Golden Gate Park. With a Walk Score of 98, this is truly a Walker's Paradise. Easy freeway access ensures seamless regional connectivity, blending classic San Francisco charm with modern urban convenience.
